goal: Allow the successor/local browser agent to bind the observer to an already-running Chrome/Chromium remote debugging endpoint with one command.
preconditions: An existing Chrome/Chromium browser is already running with a local remote debugging endpoint.
The local browser agent can reach that endpoint.
No tunnel creation is performed by this package.
This package does not launch or install a new browser engine.

procedure: Create a Playwright page CDPSession with page.context().newCDPSession(page).
Wrap it with PlaywrightCdpTransport from CDP_OBSERVER_MODULE_V1.cjs.
Start CdpObserverModuleV1 with pageId supplied by the caller's page identity.
The adapter uses session.send/session.on and detaches on close.
playwright_binding.note: The Playwright path is an adapter to an existing Playwright Chromium session; it does not create a new browser engine.

chrome_devtools_mcp_alignment.supported_pattern: Use the same existing browser remote-debugging endpoint that Chrome DevTools MCP can attach to; the observer itself remains a local CDP module rather than invoking MCP or the successor directly.

restore_after_restart.behavior: Runner loads --state if present before starting and persists state during observation.
